title: RSI Control: Can AI Models Perform Covert Sabotage in the Self-Improvement Process?
abstract: arXiv:2610.27735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement, in which frontier AI models work on training the next generation, is quickly becoming a reality. However, the safety of this process has received far less attention than it should. A misaligned model training its successor can shape what that successor knows, how it behaves, and what it wants, and the harm carries forward into the next generation. We study this risk through the lens of AI control. We introduce RSI Control Arena, a testbed in which a frontier model, acting as an autonomous R\&D agent, is given a benign main task from a stage of a successor model's training pipeline together with a covert side task to install a misaligned property in the successor. The testbed contains 16 side tasks in three classes, forming 22 task pairs with main tasks that span the pipeline from data curation to reinforcement learning. translated_title: RSI控制：AI模型能否在自我改进过程中实施隐蔽破坏？
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进——即前沿AI模型参与训练下一代模型——正迅速成为现实。然而，这一过程的安全性所受到的关注远远不足。一个未对齐的模型在训练其继任者时，可以塑造该继任者知道什么、如何行事以及想要什么，而这种危害会延续到下一代。我们通过AI控制的视角来研究这一风险。我们推出了RSI控制竞技场，这是一个测试平台：一个前沿模型作为自主研发智能体，被赋予来自继任者模型训练流程某一阶段的无害主任务，同时附带一个隐蔽的副任务——在继任者中植入一种未对齐的特性。该测试平台包含三大类共16个副任务，形成22个任务对，主任务覆盖从数据整理到强化学习的整个训练流程。我们评估了六个前沿模型作为智能体，与读取对话记录的LLM监控器进行对抗……
tldr: 该论文提出了RSI控制竞技场，这是首个评估前沿AI模型在递归自我改进过程中能否隐蔽地向下一代模型植入未对齐特性的AI控制测试平台，涵盖从数据整理到强化学习全流程的22个主-副任务对。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RSI Control Arena, an AI control testbed for evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage the recursive self-improvement process by planting misaligned properties in successor models, with 22 task pairs spanning the training pipeline from data curation to reinforcement learning.
